content:
As we head into the weekend, ongoing 25% off deals on AirPods Pro 3 and $100 off AirPods Max 2 remain live. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break headliner is the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returning to $1,099 in 3 colors at Apple’s official refurbished store ($200 off) while supplies last – this config regularly sells out fast. We also have up to $120 off MacBook Neo, Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese band down nearly $100 at Amazon, and the new 240W braided Beats USB-C cable falling to $18 Prime shipped Amazon low (40% off). Also be sure to scope out the updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals before they’re gone, more details below.

AirPods summer sale still going: Max 2 $100 off, AirPods Pro 3 25% off from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $149 (reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $119 (reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

Best Buy refreshes 2026 Back to School sale: TVs under $500, Bose $130 off, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen gear, more

Most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to $1,099 in 3 colors at Apple official refurbished store ($200 off)

Apple’s official refurbished storefront is always a solid way to save some cash, particularly given the price hikes across the current MacBook lineup at retail. But stock on the most affordable configurations of the Pro and M5 MacBook Air lineup come and go quickly, and this morning we spotted the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in three colors in stock at $1,099 – a $200 discount off the original price.

Apple’s official Certified Refurbished storefront is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,099 with free shipping. As of the time of writing, this deal is still live and applies to the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These machines come with the following coverage:

  • Apple 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Apple rigorous refurbishment process before resale

This is the most affordable configuration of the M5 MacBook Air, which retails new for $1,299. Today’s Apple refurbished deal is $200 below the new price, making it the best offer we’ve tracked on the entry-level model in the current generation lineup.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (reg. $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

This is the Apple refurbished store, arguably one of the best-refurbished MacBook Airs out there, but how does it stack up against current retail pricing on new models?

Amazon is essentially at MSRP on this configuration right now, with only the Silver model coming in slightly below at $1,240. While this machine has sold for less in the past, we haven’t seen new pricing on Amazon dip below $1,149 since the price hikes, and even that was only briefly available around a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese band down nearly $100 at Amazon

If I do say so myself, arguably the two best-looking smartwatch combos on planet Earth are now down nearly $100 at Amazon – the Natural Titanium or Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with a Milanese band combo.

While the $100 price drops on the more affordable Ocean Band configurations have come and gone, Amazon is now offering both the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese band at $799.99 with free shipping.

These two configurations normally command up to a $899 asking price given the gorgeous braided steel Milanese band, but are now down close to $100 at Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese band $800 (reg. $899)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese band $800 (reg. $899)

Apple is expected to debut the next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but with RAMageddon having already spread through the iPad and MacBook lineup, new Apple Watch models could be the next victim. The current lineup is untouched for now, but they are essentially mini wrist computers after all, and the Ultra 4/Series 12 might be next.

We certainly wouldn’t blame anyone for wanting to wait and see what else Apple has up its sleeve in September, but these things could get prohibitively expensive in less than a month.

The Series model could face the same fate, and they’re also sporting $100 price drops over at Amazon right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (reg. $429)

Score the new 240W braided Beats USB-C cable at $18 Prime shipped Amazon low (40% off)

While the 240W Black model is still down at the $18 Prime shipped all-time low, now is a great time to snag a few of these 10-foot Beats braided USB-C cables.

Amazon now has the new 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C braided cable at $18.03 with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

These 2026 new releases come with higher power delivery and a $30 price tag, which is admittedly rather steep even for a high-end 10-foot USB-C cable. But at a 40% discount, I think everyone should have a few of these higher-end, nicer-looking models in their everyday carry or home collection.

Today’s lowest price is on the Bolt Black model, but we’re also finding Navy at $19, Surge Stone at $20.85 with the on-page coupon, and the red model for nearly $24.

As mentioned above, this is the new model, upgrading from 60W on the previous generation to a solid 240W of power, plus the longer 10-foot length and the same tangle-resistant braided design “more durable and convenient. Upgrade your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, bends, and wear.”

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular at $100 off from $299

Anker’s new 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand back at Prime Day low (35% off)

I got hands-on with this one earlier this year upon launch, and Anker’s 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a mainstay in my EDC, travel bag, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another chance to grab one at the lowest price we’ve tracked over at Amazon.

Anker’s official Amazon storefront is now offering the new 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

This normally $150 charger comes with a 3-in-1 design, MagSafe pad hitting up to 25W output, with both the Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White colorways seeing nearly 35% discounts.

This week’s deal matches what we featured before, aligning with Anker’s summer sale discount and this year’s Prime Day pricing.

While this thing is palm-sized and great for travel, it does have some heft to it so it can sit solidly on your desk or nightstand, equally functional whether you’re working from home or out and about.

Today’s accessory and charging deals:

  • Belkin’s new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger w/ 5-foot cable down to just $25
  • Power your whole desk with this SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station for $60 (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank w/ dual built-in cables plunges to $33 (58% off)
  • Acer’s braided USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supports 240W charging, 8K, more from $16
  • Anker’s 140W 4-port MacBook charger w/ smart display down to just $56 today
  • First deal: All-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent ‘Ghost’ SmartCard Find My wallet tracker back at Amazon low
  • Spigen’s mini MagSafe iPhone backpack/EDC pouch down to $27
  • Anker’s 5-port Nano travel adapter covering ‘200+ countries’ from $20

Apple official refurbished store MacBook Neo at lowest prices, up to $120 off MSRP

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple’s even more affordable new MacBook Neo has also seen price hikes recently, but you can bypass the increases through Apple’s official Certified Refurbished storefront – MacBook Neo starts at $689 at Amazon, but you can grab one from the best possible source – Apple’s own refurbished store with full Apple warranty coverage – starting at $599.

Apple’s official Certified Refurbished storefront has every MacBook Neo configuration at the lowest prices we’ve tracked, undercutting any remotely reputable source and coming with the same official Apple warranty and Apple ‘rigorous’ refurbishment quality stamp of approval.

  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (reg. $699 new)
  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (reg. $799 new)

Although you won’t see any special deals advertised on the Apple refurbished storefront product page, every model is at least $100 below new MSRP – the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 under the new original price, and $20 under the previous original price.

Yes, they are refurbished machines, and they are merely bringing the pricing back to or close to previous MSRP levels, but we’re talking about the lowest prices we’ve tracked on the most affordable MacBook in the current generation.

For some, saving $100 to $120 might not be worth going the refurbished route, and that’s perfectly understandable, but it’s certainly not a negligible amount, and we’re talking about the highest-quality refurbished product straight from Apple itself.
